title: Blink
description: Welcome to hardware coding! In this project, we will test the connection to your ESP32 by writing a simple loop to turn the onboard blue LED on and off every second.
components: ESP32 Development Board, Micro USB Cable

title: Traffic Light Simulator
description: Learn about digital outputs and timing. We will wire up Red, Yellow, and Green LEDs to recreate a real-world traffic light sequence.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 1 Red LED, 1 Yellow LED, 1 Green LED, 3 220R Resistors, Dupont Wires

title: RGB Color Mixer
description: Discover Pulse Width Modulation (PWM). By rapidly pulsing electricity, you will mix red, green, and blue light to create almost any color imaginable.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 1 RGB LED, 3 220R Resistors, Dupont Wires

title: Button State Controller
description: Introduce digital inputs. You will program the ESP32 to 'listen' for a button press. When the button is held down, an LED will light up.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 1 Button Switch, 1 LED, 1 220R Resistor, 1 10K Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: Passive Buzzer Alarm
description: Let's make some noise! You will use a button switch to trigger a loud, continuous alarm sound from the passive buzzer.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 1 Passive Buzzer, 1 Button Switch, 1 10K Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: Melody Player
description: Code can make music. Using specific frequencies, you will program the passive buzzer to play a recognizable melody.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 1 Passive Buzzer, Dupont Wires

title: Analog Reader
description: Learn to read variable data. You will turn the 10K potentiometer (a twistable knob) to dim and brighten an LED smoothly.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 10K Potentiometer, 1 LED, 1 220R Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: Smart Night Light
description: Build a light-sensitive circuit. Using the photosensitive resistor, the ESP32 will detect when the room gets dark and automatically turn on a Yellow LED.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, Photosensitive Resistor, 1 Yellow LED, 1 10K Resistor, 1 220R Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: Motion Intruder Alarm
description: Security activated! The HC-SR501 PIR sensor detects human body heat. When motion is detected, a Red LED will flash and the buzzer will sound.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, HC-SR501 PIR Motion Sensor, 1 Red LED, 1 Passive Buzzer, 1 220R Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: Obstacle Detector
description: Using infrared light, the Obstacle Avoidance Module will act like a digital eye, illuminating a Green LED only when an object blocks its path.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, Obstacle Avoidance Module, 1 Green LED, 1 220R Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: Climate Monitor Indicator
description: Read environmental data. The DHT11 sensor will read room temperature. If it is hot, the RGB LED turns Red; if it is comfortable, it turns Green.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, DHT11 Temp/Humidity Sensor, 1 RGB LED, 3 220R Resistors, Dupont Wires

title: High-Voltage Controller
description: Learn how microcontrollers control large appliances. You will use a button switch to toggle the Active 5V 2-Channel Relay with a satisfying 'click'.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 5V 2-Channel Relay, 1 Button Switch, 1 10K Resistor, Dupont Wires

title: OLED Hello World
description: Screens make everything better! You will use the I2C protocol to print 'Hello World' and draw simple shapes on the 0.96 inch OLED display.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, 0.96 in OLED Display, Dupont Wires

title: Digital Weather Station
description: Combine components for a complex project. The ESP32 will read live temperature and humidity from the DHT11 and print the data cleanly on the OLED screen.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, DHT11 Temp/Humidity Sensor, 0.96 in OLED Display, Dupont Wires

title: Ultimate Security System
description: The master project. Combine the PIR sensor, buzzer, relay, and OLED. When motion is detected, the relay activates, the alarm sounds, and the OLED displays an 'INTRUDER ALERT' message.
components: ESP32, Breadboard, PIR Sensor, Passive Buzzer, Relay, OLED Display, Dupont Wires
